mapped.title: Inicio de sesion con credenciales validas
mapped.evidence: Plan §1.1 maps login with valid credentials (john/demo) from /parabank/index.htm to /parabank/overview.htm. Steps: input[name='username'], input[name='password'], input[value='Log In']. Success signals: page title 'ParaBank | Accounts Overview', 'Welcome John Smith' visible, h1 'Accounts Overview' visible, Account Services h2 visible, accounts table with linked account numbers, 'Log Out' link visible (a[href='logout.htm']).

mapped.title: Transferencia de fondos entre cuentas propias
mapped.evidence: Plan §2.1 maps transfer-funds happy path: authenticate → /parabank/transfer.htm → h1 'Transfer Funds' visible. Form elements: input[id='amount'] (label 'Amount: $'), select[id='fromAccountId'] (label 'From account #') with dynamic options, select[id='toAccountId'] (label 'to account #') with dynamic options, button 'Transfer'. Fill amount → select distinct accounts → click Transfer → page stays at /parabank/transfer.htm, h1 'Transfer Complete!' visible, confirmation paragraph with pattern '$X.XX has been transferred from account #[source] to account #[dest].' Examples parametrize amount (1, 2); mapped to two scenario variants in scenarios_recommended.

mapped.title: Cierre de sesion
mapped.evidence: Plan §3.1 maps logout: from authenticated state (session active, 'Welcome John Smith' visible) → click a[href='logout.htm'] → browser navigates to /parabank/index.htm (optional query ?ConnType=JDBC) → page title 'ParaBank | Welcome | Online Banking', h2 'Customer Login' visible, input[name='username'] and input[name='password'] present and empty, 'Welcome John Smith' no longer present, Account Services navigation gone, indicating session cleared.

unmapped_flows.title: Cierre de una cuenta del cliente
unmapped_flows.reason: No screen or route for account closure found in ParaBank DOM. Plan §4.1 explicitly maps this as 'NO MAPEADO — close-account no existe en el DOM de ParaBank'. Evidence from plan: (1) sidebar Account Services lists exactly 8 items (Open New Account, Accounts Overview, Transfer Funds, Bill Pay, Find Transactions, Update Contact Info, Request Loan, Log Out); no 'Close Account' link. (2) Sitemap (/parabank/sitemap.htm) does not list account closure page. (3) Direct URLs (/parabank/closeaccount.htm, /parabank/close.htm, /parabank/deleteaccount.htm) return non-existent resources (no title). CONCLUSION: Drift between specification (criteria.json declares RF-004) and implementation (ParaBank does not expose account closure feature). Test NOT implemented per hard rule (no fabrication).

observations: No data-testid attributes in ParaBank DOM; all locators from semantic role, name, or id (legacy JSP)
Priority getByLabel/getByRole honored; css_fallback (name, id) applied where semantic unavailable
Inputs: username/password via name attribute; amount/account selects via id attribute
Dynamic account numbers read at runtime from select option values; no hardcoded account IDs
Session persistence via JSESSIONID; auth.setup.ts pattern (login once → storageState) aligns with style-contract auth config
